headline: Snowy Hydro 2.0 Costs Surge to A$25 Billion Amid Inquiry Calls
summary: Australia's Snowy Hydro 2.0 project costs have blown out from A$2 billion to A$25 billion, prompting critics to demand an inquiry.
why: Snowy Hydro is a major Australian state-owned renewable energy generation company affecting domestic power infrastructure.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: Massive cost overruns in national infrastructure projects can impact energy prices.
